data_residency.description: Data residency configuration for the workspace. If omitted, defaults to `workspace_geo: "us"`, `allowed_inference_geos: "unrestricted"`, and `default_inference_geo: "global"`.

display_color.description: Hex color code representing the Workspace in the Anthropic Console.
display_color.title: Display Color

external_key_id.description:
ID of the customer-managed encryption key (CMEK) configuration to use for this
Workspace. Setting this field requires CMEK to be enabled for your
organization. When set, data stored for this Workspace is encrypted with the
referenced key. Create key configurations with the External Keys API. On
Claude Platform on AWS the value for an AWS KMS key is the key's ARN, and your
organization's own key must be a single-Region key in the same AWS account and
Region as the Workspace. On that platform the key is validated against this
Workspace when it is attached, so a key-policy problem is reported as an error
on this request. This field is write-once: once a key is attached to a Workspace
it cannot be detached or replaced. To rotate key material, rotate the underlying
key on your cloud KMS; the `external_key_id` stays the same.
external_key_id.title: External Key Id

tags.description: User-defined tags as string key-value pairs. Keys may not begin with `anthropic`.
tags.title: Tags

user_profile_id.description: ID of a user profile to attach to the Workspace. Every inference request through the Workspace must then name this user profile; the API rejects a request that names none or a different one. The user profile can't be replaced or removed later; only deleting the user profile clears it.
user_profile_id.title: User Profile Id

archived_at.description: RFC 3339 datetime string indicating when the Workspace was archived, or `null` if the Workspace is not archived.
archived_at.title: Archived At

compartment_id.description:
Identifier for this Workspace's encryption compartment. When you configure an
AWS KMS customer-managed encryption key (CMEK) that isn't bound to a user
profile, reference this value in your KMS key-policy condition so the key is
scoped to this compartment. On GCP and Azure, Anthropic enforces the compartment
binding automatically; you do not need to reference this value in your key
configuration. See the CMEK integration guide for the required key
configuration; unless your organization is on Claude Platform on AWS, it
includes a separate value used during key validation. On Claude Platform on AWS
there is no separate validation value: your organization's own key is validated
against this Workspace's own value when it is attached, so if its key policy
uses the compartment condition, add this value to it before attaching the key.
compartment_id.title: Compartment Id

created_at.description: RFC 3339 datetime string indicating when the Workspace was created.
created_at.title: Created At

display_color.description: Hex color code representing the Workspace in the Anthropic Console.
display_color.title: Display Color

external_key_id.description:
ID of the customer-managed encryption key (CMEK) configuration to use for this
Workspace. Setting this field requires CMEK to be enabled for your
organization. When set, data stored for this Workspace is encrypted with the

Claude Platform on AWS the value for an AWS KMS key is the key's ARN, and your

external_key_id.title: External Key Id

type.description:
Object type.

For Workspaces, this is always `"workspace"`.
type.title: Type

user_profile_id.description: ID of the user profile attached to the Workspace, or null if it has none. Every inference request through a Workspace that has a user profile must name that profile.
user_profile_id.title: User Profile Id

ExternalKeyValidationFailedErrorDetails.description: The External Key failed Anthropic's validation, so the request was refused. The message gives the reason, if there is one.
ExternalKeyValidationFailedErrorDetails.title: ExternalKeyValidationFailedErrorDetails

ExternalKeyValidationTimedOutErrorDetail.description: Anthropic's validation of the External Key did not finish in time, so the request was refused. Wait a moment, then send the request again.
ExternalKeyValidationTimedOutErrorDetail.title: ExternalKeyValidationTimedOutErrorDetails

KeyProfileMismatchErrorDetails.description: The External Key is bound to a user profile, and the Workspace does not have that user profile. A Workspace can use only a key bound to its own user profile or a key that isn't bound to one.
KeyProfileMismatchErrorDetails.title: KeyProfileMismatchErrorDetails

UserProfileNotFoundErrorDetails.description: The request depends on a user profile that does not exist in the organization or is no longer active. The request either names this user profile by ID, or names a resource, such as an External Key, that is bound to it.
UserProfileNotFoundErrorDetails.title: UserProfileNotFoundErrorDetails

WorkspacePolicyViolationErrorDetails.description: The request breaks the organization's Workspace Policy. The message says which rule it broke; an organization admin can see and change the policy in the Console.

field.description: The request field the broken rule applies to.

WorkspacePolicyViolationErrorDetails.title: WorkspacePolicyViolationErrorDetails

SandboxEgressRestrictedErrorDetails.description: The request came from a Claude sandbox with restricted network access, which is not allowed to make this change. Send it from outside the sandbox, or from a sandbox with unrestricted network access.
SandboxEgressRestrictedErrorDetails.title: SandboxEgressRestrictedErrorDetails

ExternalKeyChangedErrorDetails.description: The external key changed while the request was validating it. Send the request again.
ExternalKeyChangedErrorDetails.title: ExternalKeyChangedErrorDetails

allowed_inference_geos.description: Permitted inference geo values. Defaults to 'unrestricted' if omitted, which allows all geos. Use the string 'unrestricted' to allow all geos, or a list of specific geos.
allowed_inference_geos.title: Allowed Inference Geos

default_inference_geo.description: Default inference geo applied when requests omit the parameter. Defaults to 'global' if omitted. Must be a member of `allowed_inference_geos` unless `allowed_inference_geos` is `"unrestricted"`.

workspace_geo.description: Geographic region for workspace data storage. Immutable after creation. Defaults to 'us' if omitted.

allowed_inference_geos.description: Permitted inference geo values. 'unrestricted' means all geos are allowed.
allowed_inference_geos.title: Allowed Inference Geos

default_inference_geo.title: Default Inference Geo

workspace_geo.description: Geographic region for workspace data storage. Immutable after creation.
workspace_geo.title: Workspace Geo
